bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (CPU blur), springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (GPU dual-Kawase blur pyramid), springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs (bilinear resample), springboard/render/src/emoji.rs (area and bilinear resample), springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs (EGL/GLES compute and render path)
summary: BifrOSt has a GPU blur pyramid and bilinear resampling, both used internally by the shell for glass and scaling. It exposes no app-facing GPU image-filter, histogram, matrix or neural-network API, and only a unary kernel base trait with a chain runner (springboard/render/src/kernel.rs), not a Metal-style kernel layer; most of the framework has no counterpart.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs (EGL/GLES device init on Mesa via GBM)
features.note: Metal-only device query. BifrOSt uses EGL/GLES on Linux, so the Apple call has no direct counterpart.

features.feature: Gaussian and box blur image filters
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/gaussian_filter.rs (separable Gaussian by sigma, box and tent); springboard/render/src/gfx.rs:476 (three-pass CPU box blur); springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:300 (GPU dual-Kawase blur pyramid)
features.note: Built on parity/team-k-metal-performance-shaders (commit 3a45ebef1): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet verified on the VM or Midget. Shell glass blur is still the separate GPU pyramid and CPU box blur; there is no app API.

features.feature: Morphological filters (erode, dilate, area min and max)
features.note: Rectangular minimum and maximum (erode, dilate, area min and area max) are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-23.rs, including edge clamping and even-side refusal. Gap: no app-facing image object, and the filters are not wired into the shell or apps.

features.feature: Convolution, median, Sobel and Laplacian filters
features.note: Convolution with a caller kernel, median, Sobel magnitude and Laplacian are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-23.rs with concrete pixel values. Gap: no app-facing image object, and the filters are not wired into the shell or apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:300 (blur pyramid for the live backdrop); springboard/render/src/laplacian_pyramid.rs (gaussian_pyramid, laplacian_pyramid, collapse)
features.note: The shell's glass uses a fixed dual-Kawase pyramid on the GPU. A CPU Gaussian and Laplacian pyramid over 8-bit planes is tested headless in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-46.rs, and collapsing a Laplacian pyramid restores the source exactly. Gap: no app API, and the pyramid is not wired into the shell or verified on Midget.

features.apple: MPSImageThresholdBinary, ThresholdToZero, ThresholdTruncate and their inverses
features.note: The five threshold modes (binary, binary inverse, to zero, to zero inverse, truncate) are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-23.rs. Gap: no app-facing image object, and the filters are not wired into the shell or apps.

Histogram binning, histogram equalization and histogram specification (filter::specify) are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-23.rs. Gap: no app-facing image object, and the filters are not wired into the shell or apps.

features.feature: Integral images and statistics (mean, variance, min and max)
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-02, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No image statistics API.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/lanczos.rs (Lanczos-3, antialiased when shrinking); springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs:341 (bilinear taps); springboard/render/src/emoji.rs:401 (area-average down, bilinear up); springboard/render/src/gfx.rs:359 (bilinear asset resize)
features.note: Lanczos-3 and bilinear and area-average paths. The Lanczos model is pure, with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet verified on the VM or Midget. Not exposed through an SDK image API.

features.apple: MPSImageAdd, MPSImageSubtract, MPSImageMultiply, MPSImageDivide, MPSImageConversion, MPSImageTranspose
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-02, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Compositing is done on the CPU in gfx.rs. No GPU arithmetic kernels or colour-space conversion API.

features.feature: Reduction filters (row and column min, max, sum, mean)
features.apple: MPSImageReduceRowMax and the other MPSImageReduce* classes
features.note: Wave 3 (theme-02, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No reduction code.

features.feature: Euclidean distance transform, guided filter, keypoints
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-metal-performance-shaders, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No vision primitives in the repo.

features.feature: Neural network graphs and CNN layers
features.apple: MPSNNGraph, MPSCNNConvolutionNode, MPSCNNPoolingNode, MPSCNNFullyConnectedNode and the other layer nodes
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/cnn_layers.rs (Network, Layer, conv2d, pool2d, dense, relu); tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-22.rs
features.note: A Network chains convolution, pooling, dense, relu and custom layers, checks every shape before it runs, and is tested headless. Gap: there is no graph object, no node classes for apps, no GPU path and no serialised model.

LSTM and GRU single steps are implemented, and the tests check a bounded LSTM state over a sequence and the refusal of a hidden state of the wrong length. Gap: there is no sequence layer that runs many steps, no training layer and no matrix inference layer for apps.

features.feature: Matrix and vector kernels (multiply, decomposition, solve, softmax)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Wave 4 (w4-metal-performance-shaders, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No GPU linear algebra in springboard.
Ray intersection is not a desktop-shell need, and the framework's acceleration structure classes are deprecated in the Apple docs.

features.feature: Kernel base classes and keyed archiving
features.apple: MPSKernel, MPSUnaryImageKernel, MPSBinaryImageKernel, NSKeyedArchiver with MPSKeyedUnarchiver
features.note: An app defines a kernel by implementing ImageKernel with its class, the built-in kernels implement it too, and apply_chain runs kernels in order; all tested headless. Gap: there is no GPU kernel dispatch, no keyed archiving of kernels, and the code is not wired into the shell or apps.

gaps: No app-facing GPU compute or image-filter API. The GPU path (springboard/src/gpu/) serves the shell only.
No histogram, threshold, morphology, convolution or statistics filters for images.
No neural network or recurrent layers, and no ML inference runtime anywhere in springboard.
No GPU matrix or linear algebra kernels.
Resampling is bilinear or area-average in the shell. Lanczos exists only as an unwired pure model (springboard/render/src/lanczos.rs).
Blur is shell-internal. The Gaussian, box and tent model (springboard/render/src/gaussian_filter.rs) has no SDK entry point and is not used by the shell.
